unpivot: Emit one row for each rxnorm_code from active_stock_tracked_drugs. Read the wide field whose key is that rxnorm_code. Ignore every other key.

columns.name: reporting_month
columns.rule: date on the first of the month

columns.name: in_stock
columns.from: the wide field keyed by rxnorm_code
columns.rule: empty for unknown and never coerced to 0

columns.name: submitted_at
columns.rule: response time when the form records it
